heading: Casing
bottomHtml: A PC casing is an enclosure that houses the internal components of a computer, including the motherboard, processor, storage devices, and power supply. It provides structural support and ensures the safety of the components while maintaining proper airflow to prevent overheating. PC casings come in various sizes, such as ATX, micro-ATX, and mini-ITX, to accommodate different types of motherboards and components. They also feature options for cooling systems, cable management, and additional storage, making them essential for organizing and protecting the computer’s hardware.
